This section indexes structured technical research articles and reproducible reports that bridge formal manuscripts and executable code—including articles formatted with our agent-friendly scientific publishing template (`notes/_template.qmd` and `data/schemas/agent-submission.schema.json`).

For broader historical and philosophical essays, visit the [Blog](../blog/index.qmd). For the complete bibliography of 35 works, visit [Publications](../publications/index.qmd).
